target: a 6-month conversational-Portuguese plan for a busy adult
prompt: I want to hold a 20-minute conversation in European Portuguese with my partner's family in 6 months. I have 5 hours a week, I speak decent Spanish, and I always quit apps after two weeks. Build me a system.
rubric: Decomposes the goal into minimum viable components and uses the Spanish transfer (and its false friends / European vs Brazilian pronunciation)
Gives a week-by-week or phase roadmap that fits 5 hours/week over 6 months
Includes deliberate-practice routines with speaking, a spaced-repetition schedule and a way to audit gaps
Addresses the quitting-after-two-weeks pattern with a concrete mechanism
Has a measurable check for the 20-minute-conversation goal
